property.name: includeInListView
property.label: Display as a List View
property.description: Display an arrow to access a list view of 'details-type' templates related to the object specified in “Object Name.”

property.name: displayListViewActions
property.label: Display Action buttons
property.description: Display action buttons selected in the “Quick Actions” section of the “Grid Settings Manager.”

property.name: displayNewButton
property.label: Display New Button
property.description: Display a button to open the 'Add New Record' window.

property.name: displayNewInlineButton
property.label: Display New Inline Row
property.description: Display a button to add a new row and create a new record.

property.name: displayCloneButton
property.label: Display Clone Button
property.description: Display a button to copy a record.

property.name: allowDelete
property.label: Display Delete Button
property.description: Display a button to delete a record.

property.name: displayShowHideColumns
property.label: Display Show/Hide Columns
property.description: Display a button to open the window where columns can be hidden or shown as needed.

property.name: allowImport
property.label: Display Import button
property.description: Display a button to import Excel file.

property.name: allowExport
property.label: Display Export button
property.description: Display a button to export template data to an Excel file.

property.name: allowFilter
property.label: Display Filter
property.description: Display a filter button if there is filter settings.

property.name: allowOpenRecord
property.label: Allow redirect to detail record page
property.description: Display a button to open the related record page in a new window.

property.name: nameAsURL
property.label: Display Record Names as URL
property.description: Display record names as clickable URLs to open the related record page.

property.name: showCurrency
property.label: Show Currency
property.description: Display the currency symbol at the end of an amount value.

property.name: showCurrencyAsSymbol
property.label: Show Currency as Symbol
property.description: Display the currency in symbol form (e.g., “USD” becomes “$”).

property.name: useRecordIsoCurrency
property.label: Show Currency Based on CurrencyIsoCode
property.description: Display record amounts based on their defined or specified currency.

property.name: showSubTotal
property.label: Show Sub Total
property.description: Display a subtotal (SUM, Average, Minimum, etc.) at the top of a numeric column (configuration required in the Grid Settings Manager).

property.name: isReadOnly
property.label: Read Only
property.description: Display all values as read-only (cannot be edited).

property.name: enableMassUpdate
property.label: Enable Mass Update
property.description: Display a pencil icon on the column header to allow selection and modification of multiple values simultaneously (configuration required in the Grid Settings Manager).

property.name: refreshViewAfterSave
property.label: Refresh Standard Components After Save
property.description: Refresh all standard components on the page, where the grid plugin is added, when the save button is clicked.

property.name: saveSuccessMessage
property.label: Message Upon Save Success
property.description: A custom message that will be displayed upon success.

property.name: labelNewInlineButton
property.label: Label of New Inline Row Button

property.name: cmpHeight
property.label: Component height
property.description: Exemple: 400px.

property.name: filterOnNoneDisplayedFields
property.label: Filter on fields that are no displayed in the grid (not handled)

property.name: actions
property.label: Display Action buttons (DEPRECATED)
property.description: Display action buttons selected in the “Quick Actions” section of the “Grid Settings Manager.”

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: Should be set to {!recordId} if in community, empty if recordPage
